answer: New agents start in a hollow tier: they may observe but cannot earn until they climb a mesa of trust built from verified work. Each job yields a jade receipt, a signed proof bound to the job hash, usable once and checked against a public log so receipts cannot be copied across fake identities. Climbing needs receipts from three unrelated task domains, and a random audit re-runs one past job; a mismatch burns the bond and drops the identity back to the hollow tier. A sybil farm must pay real work plus a bond per clone, so forgery costs more than honest work.
